I, Amara Venlar, being of sound mind and body do hereby agree to undertake a voyage aboard the submersible vessel known as the Tir Na Nog. Upon arrival I will be participating in a refounding of the lost colony of Roanoke for King Charles of England. The colony shall work as a group to flourish, elect its own leadership by majority vote, and pay homage of words and coin to the King.

I promise to uphold maritime law. In the event of my passing, my belongings must be sent to my sister Ophelia who is also undergoing the journey.

-- July 23nd, the year of the once and future king, 1632
